key_components.name: PDF / Print Export View
key_components.description: Clean print-optimized summary report layout formatted in Indonesian for official records or personal decision drafting.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure complete adherence to UU Cipta Kerja (PP 35/2021) formulas for Pesangon, UPMK, and UPH.

Formulas reference: UP (1-9 months base wage depending on years worked), UPMK (0-10 months wage for 3 to 24+ years worked), UPH (15% replacement rights or unused leave + transport home). Multipliers apply based on reason (e.g. Resign = 0x UP + UPH, PHK Efisiensi = 0.5x or 1x UP + 1x UPMK + UPH, Pensiun = 1.75x UP + 1x UPMK + UPH).
Format all monetary numbers into standard Indonesian Rupiah (e.g., Rp 15.000.000) using NumberFormat or custom utility.
Build a robust IndexedDB utility (using IDB or native IndexedDB API) so users can save calculation snapshots locally without login.
Provide interactive slider controls alongside numeric inputs for easy mobile tweaking.
Use Recharts ResponsiveContainer for fluid 5-10 year projection charts.
Include print/PDF styling (@media print) to render a pristine single-page executive career summary report.
Verify all interactive buttons, tabs, inputs, and results carry the designated data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid visual monotony: balance card surfaces, dense data tables, mono text figures, and vibrant status badges.
Do not center-align body text or numeric tables; keep left-aligned or tabular right-aligned for financial amounts.
Every state change (calculating, tab switching, saving to history) should have smooth transitions and micro-feedbacks using sonner toasts.
All containers with borders must feature padding p-4 to p-6 to prevent content collision.
Never hardcode mock sample calculations without clear clear/reset actions.
